tools.name: cloudhosting_get_project_status
tools.description: Refresh and return the server status from Hetzner. [scope: read]

tools.name: cloudhosting_list_deploys
tools.description: Deploy history for a project (last 20). [scope: read]

tools.name: cloudhosting_get_logs
tools.description: Fetch container logs over SSH from the project server. [scope: read]

tools.name: cloudhosting_get_hetzner_status
tools.description: Whether your Hetzner token is connected (never returns it). [scope: read]

tools.name: cloudhosting_get_usage
tools.description: API/MCP calls this month against the free quota. [scope: read]

tools.name: cloudhosting_export
tools.description: Export all your objects (json, or csv of projects). [scope: read]

tools.name: cloudhosting_get_account
tools.description: Plan, project limit and usage of the account. [scope: billing]

tools.name: cloudhosting_create_project
tools.description: Register a project (repo + server size). Creates no server. [scope: write]

tools.name: cloudhosting_deploy_project
tools.description: Deploy (creates or redeploys the server in YOUR Hetzner account; Hetzner bills you). Requires confirm=true. [scope: write]

tools.name: cloudhosting_destroy_server
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete the project server from your Hetzner account. Requires confirm=true. [scope: write]

tools.name: cloudhosting_delete_project
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete a project record (server must be destroyed first). Requires confirm=true. [scope: write]

tools.name: cloudhosting_preview_deploy
tools.description: Dry run: check a public repo + branch and show what a deploy would create. Public, no key, creates nothing.

tools.name: cloudhosting_get_pricing
tools.description: Public plan prices and the agent API quota.
